title: NEON DASH
hook: A four-lane light race. Mash to run, hit boost pads, jump the laser gates when they are live.

theme.artStyle: neon arcade vector, glowing outlines on deep navy
theme.keyArtPrompt: Four glowing neon racing lanes stretching to a bright finish line, pulsing magenta laser gates across the lanes, cyan boost chevrons, light-trail runners, Tron style, no text

sprites.player: glowing neon runner avatar with a light trail
sprites.laser: glowing neon red laser gate beam
sprites.boost: glowing neon cyan chevron boost pad

timeline.hostLine: Watch the lasers! Jump only when they're live!

host.intro: Mash RUN. JUMP live laser gates. First to the finish wins!
host.tutorial: Mash RUN to sprint. JUMP when a laser gate is live. Boost pads speed you up.
